texto:
My name is Ana, and I live in a big city. Last year, my neighbors and I decided to start a community garden. We found a small, empty space near our apartment building and we started working together. At first, it was hard work. We had to clean the area and prepare the soil. But soon, our little garden began to grow.

Now, we grow many different vegetables like tomatoes, carrots, and lettuce. The food is always fresh and healthy. We share everything we grow with the people in our community. The garden is also a great place to meet people. I talk to my neighbors every weekend while we work with the plants. It's a very social and relaxing activity.

I think our community garden is more than just a place to get food. It's a special place where people connect with nature and with each other. It makes our neighborhood a better and friendlier place to live.

preguntas.pregunta: According to the text, what is one benefit of the community garden?

opciones.A: It is a place to sell vegetables.
opciones.B: It helps people connect with their neighbors.
opciones.C: The work in the garden is very easy.
opciones.D: Ana started the garden all by herself.
opciones.E: The garden only grows flowers, not food.

preguntas.explicacion: La respuesta correcta es B porque el texto menciona que el jardín es un lugar para socializar. Ana dice, 'The garden is also a great place to meet people. I talk to my neighbors every weekend...'. Esto muestra que el jardín ayuda a la gente a conectarse. The other options are incorrect. La opción A es falsa porque el texto dice 'We share everything', no que venden los productos. La opción C es incorrecta porque el texto afirma que al principio 'it was hard work'. La opción D es incorrecta porque Ana empezó el jardín con sus vecinos ('my neighbors and I'). La opción E es incorrecta porque cultivan vegetales ('we grow many different vegetables').

preguntas.pregunta: What can be inferred about Ana's neighborhood before the garden was created?

opciones.A: It was a very green and natural area.
opciones.B: All the neighbors were already close friends.
opciones.C: The neighbors did not interact with each other very much.
opciones.D: There were many places to buy fresh vegetables.
opciones.E: Ana did not like living in her neighborhood.

preguntas.explicacion: La respuesta correcta es C. El texto no lo dice directamente, pero podemos inferirlo. Ana dice que el jardín es un lugar donde 'people connect with... each other' y que 'makes our neighborhood a better and friendlier place to live'. Esto sugiere que, antes del jardín, los vecinos no se conectaban tanto y el vecindario era menos amigable. The other options are not supported by the text. La opción A es improbable, ya que usaron un 'small, empty space' que tuvieron que limpiar. La opción B es lo contrario de lo que se infiere. No hay información en el texto para apoyar las opciones D o E.
